narrative:
## Handover Summary — Subscriber & ARPU

Revenue validated across five segments, nine product families and four markets. The Subscriber & ARPU Agent generated 15 proposals; 11 were accepted.

## Key Decisions
• Gamma Business −1.0% on faster legacy ceases, with a PhoneLine+ migration push to 8.1k lines a month
• Q4 Horizon gross adds re-phased to 15.2k seats a month (partner under-delivery pattern)
• Germany −0.8% on platform migration timing; cross-sell ahead of plan
• April 2027 price rise modelled at 4.5% (+GBP 11M recurring)

## Open Items
• Legacy retention via migration — 64% today against a 78% target
• Top 7 partners hold 41% of the GBP 18.6M recurring revenue at risk
